storyline.real: Piquet leads from the start and makes his routine stop for fuel and tyres on lap 28 without losing the lead; once Prost's Renault is out with turbo failure he turns his boost down, lets Patrese through and takes third and the title by two points

mastery.label: Beat Piquet's real third place and still take the title

hidden.label: Turn the boost down once Prost is out: no more than 14 laps at standard pace

eras.briefing: Kyalami, October 1983, the last race of the season. Prost leads the championship on 57 points, Piquet has 55 and Arnoux 49. Brabham plan a stop for fuel and tyres mid-race. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.
